identity_paragraph: 13-year-old Indian-American girl with a warm medium complexion and expressive dark brown eyes behind round glasses, thick glossy black waist-length single side braid over her left shoulder with a woven texture, no twin braids, no bun, pencil tucked behind her ear with a plum notebook under her arm and an animated storyteller gesture, cadette scout vest with patches over a plum shirt and modest full-length uniform pants, animated comic-book style with fine calligraphic dip-pen linework, plum-and-mulberry watercolor-bleed halftone shading, sheet-music accents, plain warm-white background.
